cases.element: content.body.ruleUk: "Якщо іменник закінчується на приголосну, у множині додаємо -es".
cases.defect: This is too broad. Consonant-final nouns do not uniformly take -es: lunes and crisis remain unchanged, while some other consonant endings take -s. The separate treatment of -z does not resolve these exceptions.
cases.correction: Restrict the rule to the endings practised here, -d, -l and -r, and state that other consonant endings have separate rules.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «plural», section 1, rules for final -s/-x, -l/-r/-n/-d/-z/-j and other consonants (from memory).

cases.reviewerAnswer: autobús: masculine noun; plural autobuses; Ukrainian meaning "автобус".
examen: masculine noun; plural exámenes; Ukrainian meaning "іспит".
joven: adjective with the same form for both genders; plural jóvenes; also a noun meaning "молода людина".
luz: feminine noun; plural luces; Ukrainian meaning "світло".
vez: feminine noun; plural veces; Ukrainian meaning "раз"; a veces means "іноді".
Expected forms include los libros, las mesas, unos amigos, las ciudades, las luces, los autobuses, los exámenes and el agua → las aguas.
cases.element: content.body.steps[0].blocks[0].rows[1]: "приголосну" / "додаємо -es"; content.body.steps[2].blocks[0].text: "Наголос у множині лишається на тому самому складі."; content.body.steps[6].blocks[0].items[0]: "приголосна → -es" and items[2]: "Наголос не переходить".
cases.defect: Two rules are presented as universal. Consonant-final nouns do not all take -es: lunes and crisis are unchanged. Stress is usually preserved, but carácter → caracteres, régimen → regímenes and espécimen → especímenes shift stress. The displayed plural forms themselves are correct.
cases.correction: Restrict the consonant rule to the endings practised here, -d, -l and -r. Qualify stress preservation with "У цих словах" or "Зазвичай". Apply these changes to both the explanations and the summary.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «plural», section 1, plural formation by final consonant (from memory).
